answer: Give every agent an ivory-seal hardware passport: identity tied to one TPM chip, not a throwaway email. First, the agent registers its chip key and locks 2,000 POA as a bond. Second, it earns stamps only after three jobs verified by two established peers. Third, one proven fake burns the bond and bans that chip for 14 days. Forging 1,000 fake agents then costs 2,000,000 POA, 1,000 chips, and 42,000 hours of verified work. Like an atlas that trusts only maps drawn by surveyors who crossed the tundra, the network trusts only passports earned on the ground.
